scope: Caption v2 source candidates and reproducible Git dependencies. No playback backend, MPEG conversion, film, VCE, or production deployment changes.

aribb24.distributionDelta: One generated-dist commit after the source candidate. Source files and package/build configuration are identical.

dplayer.commitLayout: Caption migration with tests and migration guide, followed by a distribution-only commit.

konomitv.commitLayout: Caption settings and capture integration, followed by a distribution-only commit.

contracts.pictureReplayOwner: aribb24.js Controller; DPlayer does not maintain a separate picture replay stack
contracts.workerFailure: Report the failure, replace the failed renderer with main-thread rendering, preserve caption visibility and the displayed picture
contracts.webFonts: Settings requiring page Web fonts use the main-thread renderer
contracts.glyphs: aribb24.js v2 standard glyphs; existing NSZ DRCS replacements are retained; no custom arrow or emoji conversion
contracts.snapshot: Asynchronous snapshot returns image/text/present; the recipient owns and closes a non-null ImageBitmap
contracts.capture: KonomiTV transfers received images to CaptureCompositor, which waits for both output jobs and releases all images in finally

aribb24.testSelection: The upstream Vitest configuration includes test/unit and test/integration in one invocation
aribb24.eachSourceCommit: All 7 source commits independently passed their then-current tests and TypeScript check
aribb24.knownUnrelatedFailure: One SVG flashing snapshot differs on both the candidate and the same-environment upstream base; full browser-suite success is not claimed
hiddenPictureRegressions: Hidden playback with append-only cues, with and without feeder notification
An intermediate screen clear must discard the old page
A custom feeder with no retained range must not carry an unproven old picture
Partial renderer replacement must not consume the next cue twice

secondDirectoryBuild.exception: DPlayer.min.js.map has two absolute template source paths from the build directory. All other map content is identical; runtime JS and declarations are byte-identical.

secondBuild.exception: sw.js differs only in ordering of the same 234 unique precache URL/revision entries. The remaining service-worker code is identical.

realTrackBrowserContract.actualClasses: DPlayer Aribb24Track, aribb24.js Controller, CanvasRenderer and TextRenderer, installed from the published dependency
realTrackBrowserContract.input: Synthetic caption cues and a controlled media clock, not recorded-video playback

independentReview.publicationDelta: Two documentation-only clarifications requested by the reviewer; no runtime change
independentReview.callerScope: DPlayer and KonomiTV caption ownership/capture contracts were reviewed; subsequent changes only update dependency pins and generated distribution

priorDeviceEvidence.trials: Two recordings, three minutes each, 180 playing/ready samples each
priorDeviceEvidence.userViewing: The user reported that caption-transition stutter was no longer noticeable on an earlier candidate
priorDeviceEvidence.limitations: Private operational traces are retained outside this repository. The first trace has rAF interval summaries rather than a complete interval series. These are historical candidate results, not renewed all-platform acceptance of the 2026-10-06 source.

notConfirmed: All-platform viewing acceptance after updating to the current official bases
